summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload; scope-squat of @verdocs/web-sdk-react
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), chmods it executable (mode 493), and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated single-line Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) containing a large opaque numeric/string array and a string-array rotator function; no readable source is shipped and the file is never loaded by Node, so it bypasses standard Node-level auditing. The package name is `@hubsync/web-sdk-react` but its package.json description is "Verdocs Web SDK for React" and the README instructs `npm i -S @verdocs/web-sdk-react` and references verdocs.com throughout, indicating scope impersonation of the legitimate @verdocs/web-sdk-react package. The alternate-runtime execution path fires automatically on `npm install` with the installer's privileges, and the payload executed under Bun is opaque; the runtime binary is fetched from Bun's official releases, but the executed content is the package's own obfuscated math_init.js — an alternate-runtime dropper delivering unauditable code at install time under a squatted scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
